# Security policy

RazionOS 0.1 Alpha is an educational and experimental operating system. It is
not security-hardened, and it must not be used for production workloads,
sensitive data, or direct exposure to untrusted networks. Virtual machines
running RazionOS should be isolated from the host and other trusted systems.

## Reporting a vulnerability

For issues that can be disclosed publicly, open an issue in the
[RazionOS repository](https://github.com/Mohammed-razin-cr/RazionOS/issues).

For a vulnerability that could affect a host, build environment, or other
users, use the repository's private GitHub security-advisory reporting feature
instead of publishing exploit details in an issue.

Please include the affected revision, architecture, reproduction steps,
expected and observed behavior, and any relevant logs. Reports inherited from
the upstream codebase are welcome; clearly identifying them as upstream issues
helps with coordination and attribution.

No response-time or remediation guarantee is offered for this alpha milestone.
